content: Web MIDI's MIDIMessageEvent.timeStamp is a DOMHighResTimeStamp on the same monotonic clock as performance.now() (i.e. relative to performance.timeOrigin), NOT the AudioContext's internal currentTime clock (which is zero-based from context creation). To align MIDI input timestamps with the metronome's AudioContext-scheduled beat times, correlate the two clocks once via AudioContext.getOutputTimestamp() (returns paired {contextTime, performanceTime}) or by recording performance.now() alongside an audioContext.currentTime sample at startup, then applying a constant offset thereafter.
